design: 15 single-force workloads, all five nonzero channels. Receiver and layer sweeps: N=256, dt=.5 s. Geometry sweeps: N=256, dt=2 s, fixed 512 s window. The original mild layer-gradient family is retained; all Q values 10000. This is a separate campaign, not pooled with historical moment/force timings.
reference: Unmodified FK 3.3 propagation/source/Bessel kernels with a separately named FP64 integer-grid and in-memory I/O adapter. FK kernel evaluation stays outside the receiver loop. This is not elapsed time of stock fk.pl or the stock SAC executable.
parallel_reference: Additional OpenMP adapter parallelises independent frequencies, makes model/layer COMMON blocks thread-private, renames adapted files/routines/COMMON names, and copies the model into each worker. No physical arithmetic changes. Upstream FK has no OpenMP/MPI directives; this parallel capability is added by this study.
precision: FP64 C, CUDA and FK; FK compiled -O3 -fdefault-real-8 -fdefault-double-8. Metal retains documented FP64 host / float-pair GPU contractions. No fast-math or native-target tuning.
timer: perf_counter around complete in-memory calls: per-call input preparation, integration, GPU synchronisation/transfers when applicable, host inverse FFT/damping, and returned signal/spectrum arrays. FK uses ctypes plus NumPy synthesis and no SAC disk output. GRTM includes its existing temporary-model-file and fixed-array overhead. Excludes imports, solver/context setup, grid choice, correctness checks and archive writes. Native integration times also retained, not substituted for complete-call times.
order: Two warmups per configuration; five timed rounds rotate all five configurations. All trials retained. One native worker means no core pinning.
validation: Archive all five channels at every receiver, full signal and full spectra. Compare each output to same-host serial FK, and GRTM parallel/GPU to C1. Check FK OpenMP at one thread and configured thread count against serial FK; retain hashes for every timed output. Relative-L2 <1e-4 per channel is the declared FK/GRTM agreement diagnostic, and <1e-12 for serial/OpenMP FK. Failures and slowdowns retained; consistency is not quadrature convergence. Nonfinite output is marked invalid.
baselines: Report same-host serial FK / device; same-host parallel FK / device; same-host C1 / device. Also report FK serial / FK OpenMP. No cross-host ratio described as algorithmic speedup.
load: Remote measurements proceed under author-authorised ambient/shared load, with before/after telemetry for each case. No unrelated processes stopped.
publication_scope: Benchmark inputs and numerical records only. Implementation and adapter sources are not distributed in this community repository.
